reason_for_revision: In v0.2 the paired lag-difference statistic algebraically cancels the butterfly clock and reduces to pseudo_resource_year - actual_resource_year. That is useful for resource-timing specificity but is insufficient by itself to establish resource-consumer temporal precedence. No global single-host chronology outcome had been inspected when this correction was frozen.

primary_panel.source: Outcome-blind introduced-only HOSTS-WCVP resource panel for the frozen 31 butterfly species
primary_panel.paired_control: rank-1 nearest matched alien non-host in the same WGSRPD3 region, selected before local chronology is inspected

clocks.actual_resource: earliest exact-WGSRPD3 GBIF record in 1800-2025 for the single introduced known host
clocks.pseudo_resource: earliest exact-WGSRPD3 GBIF record in 1800-2025 for the paired alien non-host

primary_endpoint.inclusion: cells with dated local actual-resource, pseudo-resource and butterfly first records
primary_endpoint.statistic: discordant paired cells: actual-only precedence versus pseudo-only precedence
primary_endpoint.test: one-sided exact McNemar/sign test on discordant pairs
primary_endpoint.interpretation: Tests whether the documented known resource preferentially predates the butterfly relative to an alien non-host with matched invasion/recording history in the same region.

secondary_identity_timing_endpoint.interpretation: Positive values mean the actual known host was locally documented earlier than the matched non-host; the butterfly clock cancels from this contrast.
tests: sign-flip randomization of mean and median

required_reporting: species-level median paired direction and sign test
actual-host-level median paired direction and sign test
WGSRPD3-region-level median paired direction and sign test
cluster_robustness.purpose: Diagnose pseudoreplication from repeated butterflies, hosts or regions; these are robustness checks rather than replacements for the frozen cell-level paired endpoint.

strong_support_rule: Call the pattern identity-specific resource-consumer temporal mismatch only if the primary precedence test is positive (p <= 0.05, actual-only > pseudo-only), the secondary actual-versus-pseudo timing contrast is directionally supportive, and the effect is not confined to one butterfly species.
null_rule: If actual-only precedence does not exceed pseudo-only precedence, reject the resource-consumer temporal-mismatch interpretation even if actual host plants are generally older than pseudo plants.
boundaries: First records are detection/digitization dates, not establishment dates.
Known-host presence does not prove local larval use or demographic benefit.
Matching controls measured alien-plant residence/recording structure but cannot eliminate all horticultural or collection-history differences.
The original GEB main manuscript remains unchanged.
Do not use invasion debt, trophic debt or colonization debt as headline language unless the primary precedence test is positive and robust.
stop_rule: If the paired precedence primary test is null, terminate the temporal-mismatch branch rather than adding further timing models or simulations.
